name: Line Blame
description: See who changed a line, when and why, without leaving Orca. Click a line for its commit, then step back through the commits that changed it before.

cover.alt: A code file in the Blame view: the clicked line shows its author, date and commit title, and a card shows what that commit changed.

screenshots.alt: The clicked line shows who changed it and when; a card shows the commit message and the line before and after.
screenshots.caption: Click a line to see who changed it. Hover to see what the commit changed.

screenshots.alt: The card pinned on an earlier change of the same line, with buttons to step earlier and later.
screenshots.caption: Step back through every commit that changed the line.

screenshots.alt: The find bar open with every match highlighted in the file.
screenshots.caption: Find in the file; each match shows its blame.
